items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: And little, yeah, taught him, little George.

ctx.x: So we'll be getting him some of these days too. But some of those younger fellows, we let them go and we figured we'd get the older people that know more history first, but actually he knows more than most of the young men.
Yeah, but the judge taught him. He used to be out all over the time. And little, yeah, taught him, little George.
It's hard to think that your husband taught Joe Oliver and also somebody young like...
